QuestInfo.0: Talk to Longorias about the Fight for Azwan.
QuestInfo.1: Enter Supply Mode in Fight for Azwan and retrieve the Azwan Supply Box.\n\n#i4033160##t4033160# #b#c4033160#/100

0.0: Collecting supplies is just as important as fighting on the front lines. It should be somewhat safer, but you still have to watch your back.
0.1: Bring back #b100 Supply Boxes#k from Hilla's soldiers. We can make sure to supply our troops while we steal from theirs.

no.0: I guess you're looking for more fierce battles.
